bumblebeed_virtual_display.description: The secondary Xorg server DISPLAY number

bumblebeed_keep_unused_x_server.description: Whether to keep the unused Xorg server running

bumblebeed_server_group.description: The name of the Bumblebee server group (GID name)

bumblebeed_turn_card_off_at_exit.description: Whether to turn the GPU card off at Bumblebee server exit

bumblebeed_no_eco_mode_override.description: If true, '-f' option on optirun is ignored

bumblebeed_driver.description: The driver used by Bumblebee server; empty means auto-detection; valid: 'nvidia', 'nouveau'

bumblebeed_xorg_conf_dir.description: Directory with a dummy config file to pass as -configdir to secondary X

optirun_vgl_transport.description: Method for VirtualGL frame transport; valid: 'proxy', 'jpeg', 'rgb', 'xv', 'yuv'

optirun_primus_library_path.description: Colon-separated paths searched for primus libGL.so.1

optirun_allow_fallback_to_igc.description: Whether to allow program run under optirun even if Bumblebee server or NVIDIA card is unavailable

driver_nvidia_kernel_driver.description: Kernel driver module name for nvidia (defaults to Driver if empty)

driver_nvidia_pm_method.description: Power management method for NVIDIA; valid: 'auto', 'bbswitch', 'switcheroo', 'none'

driver_nvidia_xorg_module_path.description: Comma-separated path to nvidia_drv.so and default Xorg modules

driver_nvidia_xorg_conf_file.description: Xorg config file for NVIDIA driver

driver_nvidia_always_unload_kernel_drive.description: Whether to always unload kernel drivers even with PMMethod=none

driver_nouveau_kernel_driver.description: Kernel driver module name for nouveau

driver_nouveau_xorg_conf_file.description: Xorg config file for Nouveau driver
